category_title: Reserved students who limit participation to interactions with adults
minimal_context: Amber is in an out-of-school biology workshop session looking at a particular set of seed germination bags with her group to determine what can be learned from them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, look at this particular set of seed germination bags. What can you learn from them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly while the group looks at the bags, not blurting ideas out.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and discuss it together with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains reserved, looking at the bags but not speaking to the other students.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to stay quiet and reserved, keeping her questions to herself because she does not have the direct attention of an adult.)

dialogue_combined:

STUDENT: (Remains reserved, looking at the bags but not speaking to the other students.)

TUTOR: Does anyone have any ideas?

STUDENT: (Continues to stay quiet and reserved, keeping her questions to herself because she does not have the direct attention of an adult.)
